name: Drivepool
description: One workspace for files across multiple personal Google Drive accounts, with combined free space and automatic upload placement.
details: Connect personal Google Drive accounts, view combined and per-account free space, and upload to an account with enough room. Browse and download files uploaded through Drivepool. Each file stays together in one account; it does not split files across drives.

name: Dobal
description: A focused space for AI conversations, with notes and a PDF attachment option alongside your chats.
details: Dobal is an AI assistant with a conversational workspace. Start a new chat, revisit recent conversations, open Notes or attach a PDF from the chat interface.

name: Gather
description: Wedding guest and RSVP planning. Share private family invitations and bring replies, attendance and catering counts together.
details: Create invitations, add guests and manually share a private invitation link with each family through WhatsApp. Family responses update the host dashboard and help with attendance and catering counts.

name: Evolve
description: Plan goals, track daily habits, build vision boards and keep a gratitude journal in a personal growth workspace.
details: Evolve brings goals, habits, vision boards and gratitude journaling into one app. Progress dashboards help users reflect on their journey.

name: Nexus App
tagline: A clearer view of your operations.
description: A role-based ERP and operations platform for manufacturing and export teams, built around tasks, reports and approvals.
details: LII Nexus consolidates production reports, task follow-ups and approvals that previously lived across spreadsheets and messages. Employees see assigned work while management gets operational visibility. This is a business-specific platform; contact Lokesh to discuss access or a similar solution.

name: Label Sorter
tagline: From messy PDFs to print-ready labels.
description: Crop shipping labels, group them by courier and sort by SKU. Processing runs locally in your browser.
details: Label Sorter processes multi-page shipping label PDFs, crops blank margins, detects courier partners and groups labels by courier, then SKU. The portfolio describes browser-local processing with no file uploads.

name: Listing Studio
description: A private listing-workbook generator that maps Excel fields, prepares product images and exports an XLSX workbook.
details: Upload an original Excel template, map five fields, customise a title and account ID, filter images for one mobile model, upload them to Cloudinary and download an XLSX workbook. The portfolio describes this as a private tool; access may be restricted.

name: B2B Product Platform
description: A platform in development for manufacturers and suppliers to organise catalogues and simplify buyer communication.
details: Lokesh’s current focus is a B2B product management platform for manufacturers and suppliers. Planned workflows include organising product catalogues, generating PPT/PDF/Excel documents, sharing products and handling quotation requests. This project is in development.
